# Psalm 143 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-psalm of-David. O-YHWH hear my-prayer, give-ear to-my-supplications; in-your-faithfulness answer-me, in-your-righteousness.

**2** And-do-not enter into-judgment with-your-servant, for not will-be-justified before-you any living.

**3** For has-pursued the-enemy my-soul; he-has-crushed to-the-ground my-life; he-has-made-me-sit in-dark-places like-the-dead-of long-ago.

**4** And-faints upon-me my-spirit; within-me is-desolate my-heart.

**5** I-remember the-days of-old; I-meditate on-all your-deeds; on-work-of your-hands I-muse.

**6** I-spread-out my-hands to-you; my-soul like-a-land weary to-you. Selah.

**7** Quickly answer-me O-YHWH; has-failed my-spirit. Do-not hide your-face from-me, or-I-will-be-like those-going-down to-the-pit.

**8** Cause-me-to-hear in-the-morning your-steadfast-love, for in-you I-trust; make-me-know the-way in-which I-should-walk, for to-you I-lift my-soul.

**9** Deliver-me from-my-enemies O-YHWH; to-you I-have-hidden.

**10** Teach-me to-do your-will, for you my-God; your-Spirit good lead-me in-land level.

**11** For-sake-of your-name O-YHWH revive-me; in-your-righteousness bring-out from-distress my-soul.

**12** And-in-your-steadfast-love cut-off my-enemies, and-destroy all adversaries-of my-soul, for I your-servant.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **143:2**: 'Not will-be-justified before-you any living' — the most explicit OT statement of universal human sinfulness; quoted by Paul in Romans 3:20 and Galatians 2:16.

- **143:10**: 'Your-Spirit good lead-me in-land level' — one of the rare OT references to God's Spirit as personal guide.

— EMET
